description.value: Chaberton Estate Winery is the Fraser Valley's oldest winery, founded in 1981 and set on a 55-acre vineyard in South Langley roughly 45 minutes from Vancouver. Visitors can take guided tours through the crush pad, tank room, and barrel cellar before tasting award-winning 100% BC VQA wines in the boutique tasting room or at outdoor picnic tables overlooking the vines. The on-site Bacchus Bistro serves authentic French-inspired cuisine made with local ingredients, making this a genuine wine-and-dine destination for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is comprehensive and corroborates OSM contact data (phone 604-530-1736, address 1064 216 Street, Langley). The site describes an outdoor picnic area, tasting room, on-site bistro, and guided vineyard tours but contains no mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific infrastructure, so those fields are left null per the evidence-only rule. The business is clearly active with current event notices and full operating hours.
concerns: OSM addr fields omit city, province, and postal code; full address 1064 216 Street, Langley, BC V2Z 1R3 taken from website contact page.
No bike parking or cycling infrastructure mentioned anywhere on the website; a follow-up call to confirm whether racks exist on-site would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established destination winery with outdoor picnic area, on-site bistro, and wine tours in a rural Fraser Valley setting that touring cyclists would find appealing as a stop. No cycling-specific amenities confirmed, but the overall experience warrants a listing.
